blog.headline: When PPC Management Leaves Google Ads: The Hidden Costs of Automation

facebook.headline: What happens when you stop managing Google Ads directly?

instagram.headline: Automation vs. Trust in PPC Management
instagram.angle: Scaling PPC through automation shifts the challenge from managing ads to managing trust and governance.
